title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
slides: Can Microsoft's AI really beat doctors on hard cases?
Suleyman says it outperforms on diagnostic benchmarks
But benchmarks aren't real patients in real clinics
Hospitals must now ask what evidence actually matters
Test it on your hardest case before believing the claim
thread_text:
1. AI vs. Doctors

Microsoft claims its AI beats doctors on diagnostic benchmarks. Suleyman says it outperforms on hard cases. But what does that mean for real patients?

2. Benchmarks Aren't Patients

A benchmark tests patterns, not people. Real clinics have messy histories, missing data, and symptoms that don't fit tidy categories.

3. The Evidence Question

Hospitals are now asking: what evidence actually matters? A high score on a test doesn't prove the AI can handle a real emergency.

4. Test Your Hardest Case

Before trusting the hype, run the AI on your toughest diagnostic challenge. See if it truly outperforms in your context.

5. The Real Test

Would you trust an AI to diagnose your hardest case? If not, why believe the benchmark? Try it on a real case today and judge for yourself.
